claim_tested: GH116 domain architecture can be mapped onto CG33090-PC
key_finding: First GH116 structure (TxGH116, PDB 5BVU and ligand complexes). N-terminal beta-sandwich plus C-terminal (alpha/alpha)6 domain; glucoside-binding and active-site residues identified and stated to be conserved with GBA2.
context: Thermoanaerobacterium xylanolyticum enzyme, 2.0-2.3 A crystallography; GBA2 modelled by homology
confidence_and_limitations: High for the template fold. The fly and human proteins are only ~38-39% identical to TxGH116 over the aligned region, and TxGH116 has no eukaryote-specific N-terminal extension, so boundaries transferred to the fly chain carry +/- ~5-10 residues of uncertainty.

claim_tested: Identity of the GH116 catalytic pair and active-site residues
key_finding: TxGH116-isofagomine structure at 2.0 A; Glu441, Asp452, His507, Asp593, Glu777 and Arg786 dominate inhibitor binding.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Independently fixes the residue numbering used here for the catalytic pair in 5BVU.

claim_tested: An N-terminal beta-strand deletion in a GH116 enzyme abolishes glucosidase activity
key_finding: Nine human GBA2 isoforms expressed in COS-7; only isoform 1 hydrolysed 4MUG, all others at empty-vector background despite confirmed mRNA and protein. Isoforms X7/X8 lack p.F190_Q268del, described as 5 beta-strands of the N-terminal domain; isoform X1 has only a 6-residue N-terminal insertion and was also inactive.
context: Human GBA2 cDNAs, COS-7 lysates, 4MUG at 48 and 72 h, CBE control, n=3
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate to high as a prior. Lysate activity assay cannot distinguish misfolding/degradation from a folded but dead enzyme; no folding, thermal stability or localisation readout; isoform protein levels shown by western but not quantified against isoform 1.

claim_tested: A human GBA2 N-terminal truncation of the CG33090-PC type exists
key_finding: UniProt isoform 3 (Q9HCG7-3, 640 aa) is annotated 'Missing 1..287', an N-terminal truncation of the same class as CG33090-PC but 80 residues deeper.
context: Human, database annotation from a submitted cDNA
confidence_and_limitations: Low to moderate. Database-level only, no activity, stability or expression data; it was not among the nine isoforms assayed in PMID 33261081.

claim_tested: Exact extent of the PC truncation
key_finding: CG33090-PC (X2JE45, FBpp0310264, 799 aa) = 28 PC-specific residues + residues 178-948 of CG33090-PB (Q7KT91, 948 aa) with 100% identity over 771 residues. The junction maps to human GBA2 ~207 and to TxGH116 (5BVU) residue 117/118.
context: Pairwise alignment of UniProt sequences; Ensembl Metazoa FBgn0028916 isoform lengths
confidence_and_limitations: High for the fly-fly boundary (unambiguous, 100% identity). Moderate for the cross-species projection: the fly 175-195 region aligns to an indel in human GBA2, so the human-equivalent boundary is ~207 +/- 5-10.

claim_tested: Does the lost element touch the catalytic pocket or substrate channel
key_finding: Closest approach of the PC-lost segment (TxGH116 31-117) to the E441/D593 carboxylates is 8.11 A (Tyr62); to the bound 2-deoxy-2-fluoroglucosyl ligand in 5BX2 it is 8.33 A (Met64). No lost residue is among the 17 residues within 4.5 A of the ligand.
confidence_and_limitations: High within the template. Transfers to the fly only insofar as the fold is conserved; the eukaryote-specific N-terminal extension present in fly/human but absent in TxGH116 is not evaluated.

claim_tested: Is the lost element core or peripheral
key_finding: The lost segment makes 369 heavy-atom contacts (<5 A) with 145 distinct residues elsewhere in the chain, including 35 in the C-terminal catalytic domain (443-448 around nucleophile E441; 783-789 including R786). It carries 5 beta-strands of >=3 residues out of 19 in the N-terminal sandwich.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Contact counting is a proxy for interface area, not a free-energy calculation.

claim_tested: Is the remaining chain predicted to fold
key_finding: AF-X2JE45 (PC) mean pLDDT 85.9 (median 95.1); shared chain 87.7 vs 90.1 in the full-length model; only 10 of 771 residues lose >20 pLDDT. Core C-alpha RMSD to the full-length model 2.78 A over 740 pairs. The 28 PC-specific residues are disordered (mean pLDDT 35.8).
context: AlphaFold2 models of UniProt X2JE45, Q7KT91, Q9HCG7
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. AlphaFold is not calibrated for construct stability and routinely builds confident folds for truncated chains, so a high pLDDT here is weak evidence for real foldability. This is the single result that most directly competes with the seed expectation of an unfoldable fragment.

claim_tested: Does the truncation leave the fold incomplete
key_finding: Removing residues 1-177 uncovers 7138 A^2 of new solvent-accessible surface on the retained chain, 2805 A^2 (39%) of it hydrophobic; 12 residues move from relative SASA <0.10 to >0.30.
context: AlphaFold models of X2JE45 and Q7KT91, probe 1.4 A, 200 sphere points
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Computed on predicted models, and the comparison assumes the retained chain in PC adopts the full-length conformation, which AlphaFold asserts rather than demonstrates.

key_finding: Four polypeptides: PB 948 aa, PD 946 aa, PE 923 aa, PC 799 aa (FBpp0310264 = UniProt X2JE45). No phenotypic data recorded for 19 alleles beyond viable/fertile.
confidence_and_limitations: High for isoform identity. No fly product of any length has been assayed for glucosylceramidase activity in the literature retrieved here.

claim_tested: Does removing part of the GH116 noncatalytic N-terminal domain affect folding or activity
key_finding: Second GH116 crystal structure (TeGH116, Thermosynechococcus elongatus BP-1). A long loop extending from the noncatalytic N-terminal domain helps form the mouth of the active site; deletion of that loop gave poor stability and low activity, with altered relative substrate preference.
context: Cyanobacterial enzyme expressed in E. coli; crystallography plus kinetics on pNP-glucoside and gluco-oligosaccharides
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate to high. The only experimental deletion inside a GH116 N-terminal domain, but it removes one loop, not five beta-strands, and in a bacterial enzyme lacking the eukaryote-specific extensions.

claim_tested: Which GH116 signatures does CG33090-PC retain and which does it lose
key_finding: X2JE45: PF12215 50-296 (247 aa), PF04685 356-787 (432 aa). Q7KT91: PF12215 117-445 (329 aa), PF04685 505-936 (432 aa). The catalytic-region match is identical in length; the N-terminal domain match is shortened by 61 residues (18.5%). SSF48208 and G3DSA:1.50.10.10 unaffected.
context: Database signature matches on UniProt sequences
confidence_and_limitations: High as a description of the annotation. Profile HMMs score partial matches, so the surviving PF12215 annotation on X2JE45 does not mean the domain is complete.

citation: This work, InterPro family sweep (5622 PF04685 and 5475 PF12215 proteins)
claim_tested: Does the PC architecture occur among natural GH116 proteins
key_finding: PF12215 match length across 4991 two-domain proteins: median 314, IQR 305-320, with 68.6% between 300 and 330. PC is 247 (13.2nd percentile), PB 329, human GBA2 305. A PC-like architecture (match start <=60, length 150-280) occurs in 263 of 4991 (5.27%), all unreviewed; 110 of 160 sampled (69%) are UniProt class 4 Predicted against 37 of 160 (23%) for core-architecture entries, Fisher OR 7.31 (95% CI 4.45-12.02), p=1.9e-16. X2JE45 is class 4 Predicted; Q7KT91 is class 1 Evidence at protein level.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Evidence class is a proxy for annotation quality, not proof that those entries are wrong, and the sweep counts database entries rather than validated proteins.

citation: This work, Ensembl Metazoa gene structure (FBgn0028916)
claim_tested: Is CG33090-PC a real alternative product or a truncated gene model
key_finding: CG33090-RC skips RB coding exons 1 (260 bp) and 2 (270 bp), which together encode PB residues 1-177, and starts from its own exon 14342016-14342635 inside the RB intron, with a 537 bp 5' UTR and 83 bp of coding sequence (27 codons plus two bases, matching the 28 PC-specific residues), then uses the shared exons and the same stop codon. RD and RE differ from RB only in the 3' splice site of exon 3.
context: Drosophila melanogaster chromosome 2L, FlyBase annotation via Ensembl Metazoa
confidence_and_limitations: High for the model as annotated. It does not establish that the transcript is made: X2JE45 has only a genomic EMBL entry (AHN54440.1) and a FlyBase-derived RefSeq, while Q7KT91 has three independent mRNA clones.

claim_tested: Within the N-terminal domain, is the lost part the part nearest the catalytic centre
key_finding: The whole N-terminal sandwich (31-410) comes no closer than 8.11 A to the E441/D593 carboxylates, and that closest residue, Tyr62, lies inside the lost segment; the retained part (118-410) comes no closer than 14.81 A. Of 62 residues within 12 A of the anomeric C1 in 5BX2, 60 are in the catalytic domain, 2 are in the lost segment (Met64 9.40 A, Val60 11.41 A), and none are in the retained sandwich.
confidence_and_limitations: High within the template. Second-shell proximity does not establish a catalytic or binding role, and the lipid aglycone channel of GBA2 has not been observed experimentally.
